extracted.intended_audience: general news readers (and secondary: PR/marketing professionals)
extracted.subtask_description: A news report covering a corporate apology and retraction following public backlash to an advertising campaign that was perceived as sexist and culturally insensitive. Documents the company's statements, distribution channels for the apology, and public reaction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sincere acceptance of criticism and suggestions
rubrics_metrics.description: "sincerely accepts the criticism and suggestions of the public"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apology language should explicitly accept public criticism and suggestions rather than deflecting blame; use clear wording that acknowledges the public's reaction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Immediate retraction of the advertisement
rubrics_metrics.description: "announced an immediate retraction of the advertisement"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When an ad provokes justified public backlash, retracting the offending content promptly is a concrete corrective action cited by the company in the article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acknowledge the cause and take responsibility
rubrics_metrics.description: "It is the lacking of thorough consideration in creativity and details that led to the content (of the ad) making the public hold the opinion it is sexist and demeaning to females"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apologies should explain what went wrong (e.g., lack of consideration in creative process and details) and take responsibility rather than minimizing the issue.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commitment to improve practices/attitude
rubrics_metrics.description: "vowed to serve customers with a more prudent attitude"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include a pledge to change behaviour or processes (e.g., more prudence in marketing) to show steps toward preventing recurrence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of official channels and major outlets to communicate apology
rubrics_metrics.description: Apology issued "via its official account on WeChat" and also "in USA Today"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Distribute the apology through the company's official social channels and prominent media to ensure visibility across affected audiences (local and international).

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid sexist, demeaning, or vulgar content in advertising
rubrics_metrics.description: Public criticism: "Likening women to used cars? Discrimination... Such a vulgar ad! ... So low!"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Marketing content should not equate people to products, demean groups, or use vulgar portrayals; screening for sexism and discrimination in creative reviews is essential.

rubrics_metrics.name: Respect cultural sensitivities and avoid distorting cultural relationships
rubrics_metrics.description: Backlash noted because netizens saw the ad as "a distortion of Chinese marriage and the relationship between a mother-in-law and her daughter-in-law"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When targeting a specific market, assess cultural norms and relationship dynamics to avoid harmful stereotypes or misrepresentations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensure apology authenticity to avoid perceptions of insincerity
rubrics_metrics.description: Netizen reactions: "This is not an apology, but a surrender to money," and "How could it happen that no one from such a big company can explain the problem of this commercial? I don't buy it!"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apologies perceived as transactional or corporate 'surrender' risk further backlash; accompany statements with transparent explanations and tangible corrective measures to convey sincerity.
